The government of Saudi Arabia provides scholarships to sponsored students. The scholarships covers full tuition and other relevant related required
academic fees. To qualify for a scholarship undergraduate students must be registered for a minimum of 15 quarter hours and graduate students must
register for a minimum of 12 quarter hours. The scholarships do not cover costs for health insurance or costs related to Study Abroad. Students must
provide an official financial guarantee, from the Cultural Mission of the Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia each quarter. The University directly bills the
Cultural Mission for all tuition and qualified fees.
